name: truestub
description: TrueStub - a trustless P2P escrow platform for secondary-market ticket transfers, built on Stellar via the TrustlessWork API. Monorepo root: apps/frontend, apps/backend, and contracts/.

scripts.lint: yarn workspace @truestub/frontend lint && yarn workspace @truestub/backend lint
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @truestub/frontend typecheck && yarn workspace @truestub/backend typecheck
scripts.prepare: husky && (husky add .husky/pre-commit "yarn lint-staged" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true) && (husky add .husky/commit-msg "yarn commitlent --edit "\$1"" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)
